contexts.text: A little star (appears at man's resuscitation from the dead).
Wandering stars seen around a Spirit = Falsities; but not so when the stars are not wandering.
In his face were seen many wandering stars, which = Falsities. SE 4073. SE 4075.
The internal of such worship is described by... the stars not giving their light ().
They sometimes see a heaven... beautifully studded with little stars.
When the Lord pleases, good Spirits appear to others, and also to themselves, as bright stars, which sparkle according to the quality of their charity and faith.
His Human Essence is called a star out of Jacob (). AC 3322:3.
When one contemplates the starry heaven, and thinks of the Lord's Kingdom.

Number the stars () = a representation of goods and truths in a mental view of the constellations; (for) stars = goods and truths. Stars, wherever mentioned in the Word, = goods and truths; and, in the contrary sense, evils and falsities; or, what is the same, they = Angels, or Societies of them; or evil Spirits and their companies. When they = the former, they are fixed stars; but when the latter, they are wandering stars.

When the starry heaven appears (there), and the stars therein are fixed, it is known at once that they = goods and truths; and when the stars appear wandering, that they = evils and falsities. From the very glow and sparkling of the stars, it may be evident of what quality they are.
That stars = goods and truths. Illustrated.
That stars = goods and truths, or, what is the same, those in goods and truths, as the Angels. Illustrated.
The stars () = goods and truths, or the Knowledges of good and truth, which at the consummation of the age... are thus darkened.

The Knowledges of good and truth, which are the stars (), and which are here called the powers of the heavens, will thus fall down and vanish. ( = the Knowledges of faith. AC 2120.) AC 2495, Illustrated.
As the stars of the heavens () = the multitude of the Knowledges of good and truth.

The spiritual are they who here and there in the Word are compared to the stars, and this from the Knowledges of good and truth which they have; but not the celestial, because they have not Knowledges, but perceptions. Besides, the stars illumine the night, and the spiritual have a nocturnal light, as from the moon and stars, relatively to the light of day in which the celestial are.
The stars, or Knowledges, have relation to the Rational.
Twelve stars () = all things of faith; for stars = the Knowledges of good and truth, which are of faith. AC 4918:end.
The stars have withdrawn their shining () = the Knowledges of good and truth...
I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heavens () = truths, and the Knowledges of faith.
It is chiefly the stars which are called the army of the heavens; and by the stars are signified truths; and, in the opposite, falsities. AC 3614:3.
Stars of the heavens = rational things.
Such suppose that the learned will there shine as the stars... But the learned, wise, and intelligent = those who are in good... and it is these who will shine as the stars.

I then saw a little star about the region of the left eye; and afterwards many little stars of a bright red colour, gleaming whitely... Lastly I saw as it were the starry heaven... These things represented the infundibulum in the brain, above which was the brain itself, which was signified by the starry heaven.
The stars shall fall from heaven () = that the Knowledges of good and truth will perish. AC 10604:4. HH 1:2. DSS 14:2. AR 27:end.
Those who relate to the interiors of the nostrils... have apertures opening at the side, through which they see as it were heaven with stars in a blue sky.
Eleven stars () = the Knowledges of good and truth.

The reason stars = these Knowledges, is that they are small luminaries which shine at night, when they give forth into our atmosphere gleams of light, just as Knowledges give forth gleams of good and truth. Illustrated.
As stars = the Knowledges of good and truth, they = also the doctrinals of the Church; for these are Knowledges.
That the army of the heavens, and the stars = the Knowledges of good and truth. References.
Those (sensuous things) which are in the centre receive light through the Rational, and (appear there) as little stars which gleam and shed light around...
In those of (these infernals) in whom there is regard for what is good, this is sometimes represented by little stars, almost fiery, but not bright white. SE 1068.
A Spirit who appeared like a black cloud, around which were wandering stars. When wandering stars appear there, they = falsities; but fixed stars, truths. AC 7803:2.
Good makes every truth like a little star, in the midst of which there is a luminosity.
That then the Knowledges of good and truth perish, is signified by, I will darken the stars of the heavens, and all the luminaries of light (). AE 372:3. AE 401:13.
The Spirits of Mercury go forth outside the sphere of this world, into the starry heaven.
The stars of heaven () = the Knowledges of good and truth; to cast them to the earth = to destroy them.
The stars = the Knowledges of good and truth.
For the angelic abodes shine like stars; as is stated in .
Those in that Heaven appear clothed in azure, spotted with little golden stars... When, in the world, they contemplate the starry leaven, they call it the abode of the Angels...

When there is any slight disagreement among (the Spirits of Jupiter), there appears to them as it were a thin bright white ray... or a little wreath, in which are sparkling stars... When the stars sparkle and wander at the same time, it is not a good sign; but sparkling fixed stars are a good sign. ( = falsity, or truth, respectively. EU 50.)
For by the starry leaven is signified the angelic Heaven.

The dwellings (in Jupiter) within, are spotted round about and above as with little stars, after the image of the heavens; for they want to exhibit within their houses a likeness of the visible heavens with their stars; because they believe the abodes of the Angels to be there.
Stars = the Knowledges of good and truth, which will no longer have light from faith and love, thus from Heaven, which is to withdraw their brightness (). AE 400:3.

To shine as the stars () = to be in the intelligence of truth and in the wisdom of good, and thence in eternal happiness; for stars = the Knowledges of truth and good, from which are intelligence and wisdom.
The wise men... knew that a star would appear to them, concerning which Balaam... also prophesied (). Moreover a star = the Knowledges of internal good and truth which are from the Lord.
On the Earths in the starry heaven. General article. EU 123.
To cast some of the army and of the stars down to the earth () = to destroy the goods and truths of Heaven, and the very Knowledges of good and truth.
The morning stars () = the Knowledges of good and truth from good... These are said to sing when they arise.
Their sun is one of the lesser stars. AC 10162, Explained.
I will multiply your seed as the stars of the heavens () = goods and truths, and the Knowledges of them.
For by the stars are signified goods and truths as to Knowledges.

It was found that (the Spirits of the Fourth Earth) were from a star, which is their sun, very distant from the sun of our system; that its position is low down near the milky way; and that that star is among the lesser ones.
The sun (of the Fifth Earth) which to us is a star...
This human form appeared in a flaming beam, around which were little stars of the same colour. Thus did the Lord present Himself...
The sun (of the Sixth Earth) which to us is a star...
An angelic Society (was seen) as a cloud... with little stars round about... These little stars were Angels, who so appeared from light from the Lord.
In these passages, stars = the Knowledges of good and truth, which are said to be blackened, to lose their light, and to fall from heaven, when they are no longer.
A star fallen from heaven () = the Knowledges of truth destroyed.
The star which went before them () = Knowledge from Heaven.
Many have believed that they would shine as the stars...
The stars () = the Lord as to the Knowledges of good and truth.
The stars of Heaven (which the dragon dragged down with his tail) = the Knowledges of truth.
The stellar forms in the brain.
The multitude of the glands of the brain may be compared to that of the stars; and the multitude of the fibrils from them, to that of the rays which go forth from the stars.
If wisdom is not conjoined with love, it is like a falling star.
In His right hand seven stars () = all the Knowledges of good and truth in the Word, which are from it with Angels of Heaven and men of the Church. AE 72, Explained, Illustrated.

When the Angels are below the Heavens, there appear around them as it were little stars in great abundance; and in like manner around those Spirits who, while they lived in the world, acquired the Knowledges of good and truth, or truths of life and of doctrine. These little stars appear fixed with those who are in genuine truths from the Word; but wandering with those who are in falsified truths... Hence it is evident that by stars are signified the Knowledges of good and truth from the Word. AR 51:2, Illustrated.

The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in My right hand () = the arcana in the visions concerning the New Heaven. The seven stars = the Church in the Heavens. ( = revelation of goods and truths, which are all from Him. AE 88.)
The seven stars are the Angels of the seven Churches () = the New Church in the Heavens, which is the New Heaven. ( = those who receive goods and truths from the Lord. AE 90.) AR 237.

There appears in the Spiritual World a heavenly expanse full of stars, as (here); it appears from the angelic Societies in Heaven; each Society there shines as a star to those below. From this they know in what situation the angelic Societies are.

These things saith He that holdeth the seven stars in His right hand () = the Lord from whom are all truths, through the Word... The seven stars in His right hand = all the Knowledges of good and truth in the Word, which are thence from the Lord with the Angels of Heaven and the men of the Church. AE 96.
I will give him the morning star () = intelligence and wisdom then. ( = intelligence and wisdom from the Lord's Divine Human. AE 179.)

Stars = the Knowledges of good and truth; and as through these there is intelligence and wisdom, these are signified by the morning star. The reason it is called the morning star, is that intelligence and wisdom will be given them by the Lord when He will come to instaurate the New Church. Explained.
These things saith He that hath... the seven stars () = the Lord, from whom are... all the Knowledges of good and truth. AE 184.
The stars of heaven fell unto the earth () = that all the Knowledges of good and truth have disappeared. AE 402.
In the Spiritual World, stars appear to fall from Heaven to the earth there, where the Knowledges of good and truth are perishing.

There fell from heaven a great star burning as it were a torch () = the appearance of Own intelligence from conceit which arises from infernal love. ( = the truth of the Word falsified from man's Own love. AE 517.)
The name of that star is called Wormwood... () = the infernal falsity from which is their Own intelligence. ( = truth mixed with the falsity of evil. AE 519.)

A third part of the stars was smitten () = that on account of evils from falsities and falsities from evils, they did not know... what any truth is... Stars = the Knowledges of truth and good from the Word. ( = that all the Knowledge of good and truth had perished. AE 525.)
By the light of the sun is signified Divine truth spiritual; and by the light of the moon and stars. Divine truth natural, both from the Word...

I saw a star fallen from heaven unto the earth () = Divine truth spiritual inflowing from Heaven into the Church with them, exploring and manifesting. A star, here, = Divine truth spiritual, because it fell from the Spiritual Heaven. ( = Knowledges of truth which have been falsified, and thus turned into falsities. AE 535.)
The like is signified by a star, in the singular, in  and ; for by stars, in the plural, are signified the Knowledges of good and truth; and through these there is intelligence.
Under Army, see this reference.

Upon her head a crown of twelve stars () = its wisdom and intelligence from the Knowledges of Divine good and Divine truth from the Word. ( = the wisdom and intelligence of those who are of that Church through doctrinal things and the Knowledges of all things of truth and good from the Word. AE 709.)

His tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and cast them unto the earth () = that through falsifications of the truths of the Word they have alienated from the Church all spiritual Knowledges of good and truth, and have utterly destroyed them through applications to falsities. ( = the falsification and adulteration of all the Truths of the Word. AE 718. AE 714:13.)
That paper, when written on from the Word, shone like a star.
As the Angels withdrew... stars appeared around their heads.

The bright and morning star () = that He was then the light, and that He will come with new light, which will arise before His New Church... He is called the bright star from the light with which He came into the world; on which account He is called a star. Illustrated. And He is called the morning star from the light which will arise from Him before the New Church... For by a star is signified the light from Him, which in its essence is wisdom and intelligence...
The prince's robe was set with stars of a silver colour wrought in needlework.
The paper on which the arcana were written, ... while it was in the Spiritual World, shone like a star...
The infinity of God the Creator may be seen from the infinite number of the stars, which are so many suns, and thence so many worlds.
(The notion that) the stars are only luminaries which originated from our sun.

(I said to the Angels), In the world there appear innumerable stars, greater and less, which are so many suns, and which merely transmit light into the world of our sun; and when I saw that in your world also stars are to be seen, I supposed that these are as many as those in the world. The Angels were delighted with this discourse, and said that perhaps there are as many, because every Society of Heaven sometimes shines like a star to those who are below; and the Societies of Heaven are innumerable, all ordinated according to the varieties of the affections of the love of good... and, as these were foreseen before the creation, I suppose that there have been provided (an equal number of stars in the natural world).

The apostolic Church was actually like a new star appearing in the starry heaven; but, after the two Nicene Councils, the Church became like the same star darkened and lost to view; just as has sometimes happened in the natural world, according to the observation of astronomers.
The Word, in the shrines of the temples there, shines like a great star, and sometimes like the sun.
When the Angels descend from Heaven to perform any duty below, they appear encompassed with little stars, especially around the head; which is a sign that Divine truths from the Word are in them.
I saw fatuous lights, some like sheets of paper full of writing, which... at last appeared like falling stars, which in their descent vanished in the air. Explained.

Faith in the Lord, when destitute of Truths, may be compared to a new star appearing in the expanse of Heaven, which in time grows dim; but faith in the Lord, together with Truths, may be compared to a fixed star which remains constant... The faith of Truths shines in Heaven like a star.
That the Lord is the Son of the living God, is like the morning star to all who enter His Church.
Round the Angel's head appeared a lucid band, in which were minute stars.

They viewed predestination as a star descending from heaven... not knowing that a falling star is a meteor of fatuous light, which, when it falls into the brain, can confirm every falsity... until it is believed to be the true light, and is decreed to be a fixed star; and finally is sworn to be the star of stars.
Whether they believe that the stars of heaven will fall upon the earth, which is smaller than a single one of them.
The fall of Spirits from Heaven as stars.
On the seats of some in Heaven who are called stars.
On those who are called stars of the dragon.
That a star in the zenith fell down with the rest.
The appearance of little stars is a good sign.
Evil spirits also have stars around them.
On little stars.
Their face appears beset with many wandering stars... These wandering stars = an appearance of what is honourable in externals.
Around (this evil Spirit) were small wandering stars in abundance.
On the appearances to Spirits of little fires, and stars.
They who are in Truths of faith, that is, who are led by the Lord, appear like bright little stars in the hemisphere.
That there is no fixed star which has not its Earths around it.
On inhabitants of the starry heaven.
There appeared an azure starry heaven...
Evil Spirits seen around me as innumerable Wandering stars.
They look upwards to the stars, and have a revelation thence.
See Last Judgment. SE 5373.
The ordinances of the moon and stars, from which is the light by night () = truths from spiritual good, and from Knowledges, from which there is intelligence.
That he-goat then appears to tread the stars under his feet. (Just as in ).
The stars from their courses fought against Sisera () = the Knowledges of truth, and combat from them against the falsities of evil. AE 447:4.
Stars of light () = the Knowledges of truth from good.

The stars cannot fall to the earth, because they are larger than the earth; consequently by them are signified such things as are of heavenly light, and give light, which are the Knowledges of good and truth. Moreover, stars appear in the angelic Heaven; but they are appearances from the Knowledges of good and truth; and therefore they appear around those who are in such Knowledges, especially when they are turning them over in their minds, and when they long to know them.
To set it among the stars () = in the heights where those dwell who are in the Knowledges of truth.

As the Lord is the east, a star was seen by those from the east; and, as they were in Knowledge about the advent of the Lord from the representatives among them, the star was seen and went before them, first to Jerusalem, by which was represented the Church as to doctrine and as to the Word, and thence to the place where the infant Lord was. Moreover, a star = the Knowledges of good and truth; and, in the supreme sense. Knowledge about the Lord.

When to fall is predicated of the stars - by which are meant the Knowledges of good and truth from the Word to perish; for when Divine truth in the Spiritual World falls out of Heaven to the earth there, where the evil are, it is turned into falsity. Explained.
Stars = the Knowledges of truth and good. AE 632:5. AE 1029:13.
Stars = falsities in general.
That the Lord has infinite power, may be evident from the fact that... He has created the universe, full of such innumerable stars, which are suns...
Profaners of this kind appear at first with a face of a human colour around which float many wandering stars...
Those (Africans) who had believed that God had been born a man, saw a bright star in the air.
